verdict.rationale: The evidence documents pre-built, source-available triggers and actions for thousands of apps, plus community-contributed components. Those are individual building-block steps, not a public library of complete workflow templates an ops user could start from. No evidence describes a template gallery or cloning a pre-made workflow, so the applicable axis is unevidenced.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can start from a public library of workflow templates instead of building from scratch
